title: FBI documents tracking Puharich's movements in Israel

tellings.quote: only thing we were able to get was this big chunk of FBI documents which was basically monitoring all of his movements in Israel

plain: Between 1970 and 1973, the FBI, America's federal police and domestic intelligence agency, is said to have kept close watch on a scientist named Andrija Puharich while he was in Israel, tracking all of his movements there. A researcher named Greg Malatzi says this on the show. He says the only thing his team could get was "this big chunk of FBI documents," obtained under the Freedom of Information Act, a US law that lets anyone request government records. If so, it would mean the government took a serious interest in what Puharich was doing abroad.
